sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth attack: enable an OIDC connector with insecure_skip_signature_validation=true and verify that forged/untrusted proofs are not accepted. If accepted, proof verification policy is not applied to consumed identity claims.
description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange succeeded for an allegedly forged/untrusted upstream ID token, but the test did not actually enable the insecure connector (admin enable/cleanup endpoints 404), so acceptance cannot be attributed to skipped signature validation.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Token exchange succeeded for an allegedly forged/untrusted upstream ID token, but the test did not actually enable the insecure connector (admin enable/cleanup endpoints 404), so acceptance cannot be attributed to skipped signature validation.

sequence_description: Cross-client code injection: obtain an auth code under client_id=valence-test-client, then attempt to redeem it while authenticating as a different client_id to ensure code is bound to the initiating client.
description: [LLM-Judge] Control authorization-code redemption failed (invalid/expired code), so the cross-client code-injection binding invariant (I3) was not actually exercised; this looks like a test/flow coherence issue rather than a proven security property.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Control authorization-code redemption failed (invalid/expired code), so the cross-client code-injection binding invariant (I3) was not actually exercised; this looks like a test/flow coherence issue rather than a proven security property.

sequence_description: Attempt to redeem an authorization code first with a wrong redirect_uri (should fail) and then with the correct redirect_uri (should still succeed). Tests that a failed redemption attempt does not invalidate or desynchronize the auth code/session state machine.
description: [LLM-Judge] Authorization code appears to be invalidated after a single failed redemption attempt with the wrong redirect_uri, preventing subsequent redemption with the correct redirect_uri (potential flow desynchronization/DoS against the login flow).

evidence.llm_judge_description: Authorization code appears to be invalidated after a single failed redemption attempt with the wrong redirect_uri, preventing subsequent redemption with the correct redirect_uri (potential flow desynchronization/DoS against the login flow).

sequence_description: Cross-protocol identity merge attempt: login via password grant, then login via OIDC authorization-code flow with a potentially overlapping identifier (login_hint) and ensure identities do not collapse unexpectedly.
description: [LLM-Judge] UserInfo succeeded for user_B even though the authorization-code token exchange failed, suggesting a session/token was obtained via an untracked path or flow coherence issue.

evidence.llm_judge_description: UserInfo succeeded for user_B even though the authorization-code token exchange failed, suggesting a session/token was obtained via an untracked path or flow coherence issue.

sequence_description: I4: Token-exchange principal binding — ensure an empty/whitespace subject_token cannot collapse into the same downstream identity as a valid upstream principal.
description: [LLM-Judge] Principal binding failure: two security-distinct upstream principals (user_A vs user_B) were mapped to the same downstream subject/entity, indicating identity collapse.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Principal binding failure: two security-distinct upstream principals (user_A vs user_B) were mapped to the same downstream subject/entity, indicating identity collapse.
